description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of different models across a range of values on the x-axis, which is labeled “Feedback Friction” and spans from 0.91 to 0.98 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in a linear scale. The plot displays three distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers, a dashed orange line with diamond markers, and a dashed green line with square markers. The blue line remains consistently high, hovering near 1.0, starting at approximately 0.85 at x=0.91 and ending at approximately 0.99 at x=0.98. The orange line begins at approximately 0.65 at x=0.91, peaks near 0.90 at x=0.92, then steadily declines to approximately 0.09 at x=0.98. The green line starts at approximately 0.20 at x=0.91, dips to approximately 0.08 at x=0.92, and then steadily increases to approximately 0.90 at x=0.98. All lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability.
